items.title: Amazon S3 joins the Vercel Marketplace
items.summary: You can now create and connect Amazon S3 resources through the  without leaving your Vercel project dashboard.Vercel MarketplaceThe Amazon S3 Marketplace integration automatically adds connection details as environment variables and lets you manage resources alongside your application infrastructure, with links to AWS for deeper configuration. Authentication uses short-lived OIDC credentials without storing static AWS keys.Amazon S3 is also available in , which provisions resources, configures connections, and generates code from your prompt.v0type: embedded-entry-inline id: 7qqJ3BsOar5VmX4ISL8oLptype: embedded-entry-inline id: 6clFScOOxbqin6hI02xHXl provides public and private storage for application file uploads, with built-in caching and CDN delivery close to your end users. Choose the Amazon S3 integration for existing AWS workflows, analytics on managed Iceberg tables with , or vector storage and search with .Vercel BlobS3 TablesS3 Vectors. Create a new AWS account through Vercel to receive , or link an existing account and manage your plan and usage from your Vercel dashboard. Linked accounts support only new buckets created through Vercel.
